"3D OPEN-WORLD SURVIVAL RPG WITH ELEMENTAL COMBAT
1. GAME OVERVIEW @COMMENT_BODY@ CORE LOOP
Genre: 3D Open-World Survival Action-RPG.
Visual Style: 3D Voxel / Stylized Low-Poly or Realistic (optimized for smooth performance).
Core Loop: Explore Open World → Gather Resources @COMMENT_BODY@ Farm → Craft Tools/Forts → Defeat Enemies/Raid → Level Up @COMMENT_BODY@ Gain Coins → Unlock New Characters, Abilities, @COMMENT_BODY@ Skill Trees.
2. CHARACTER @COMMENT_BODY@ CLASS SYSTEM
Character Selection: Players select distinct characters at startup, each tied to specific elemental themes and weapon styles (inspired by Elemental Battlegrounds).
Class Archetypes:
Fantasy / Elemental: Focuses on magic/elemental abilities and traditional medieval melee/ranged weapons (Swords, Bows, Shields).
Tech / Ballistic: Focuses on utility/tech abilities and firearm ballistics (Pistols, Rifles, Shotguns).
3. PROGRESSION @COMMENT_BODY@ SKILL TREES
Leveling Mechanics: XP earned through combat, gathering, mining, building, and exploration.
Character Level Ups: Unlocks higher-tier active elemental abilities and passive skill slots.
Branching Skill Paths:
Stat Branch: Permanent enhancements to max Health, Health Regeneration, Stamina, Defense, and Carrying Capacity.
Ability Branch: Modifies base abilities (e.g., reduces cooldowns, increases AOE radius, adds status effects like Burn or Stun).
4. CRAFTING, BUILDING @COMMENT_BODY@ SURVIVAL MECHANICS
Resource Gathering @COMMENT_BODY@ Tool Progression:
Standard resource nodes: Wood (Trees), Stone (Boulders), Iron, and High-Tier Ore.
Tool Progression Tiering: Wood → Stone → Iron → Advanced/Fantasy Ore Tier.
Specialized Tools: Pickaxes (Mining efficiency), Axes (Chopping efficiency).
Base Building System:
Snap-grid construction system for player structures (Campsites, Outposts, Fortresses).
Defensive structures: Walls, Doors, Gates, Turrets, and Storage Chests.
Survival Mechanics:
Farming: Crop planting, watering, and harvesting for food and utility ingredients.
Raiding @COMMENT_BODY@ Purging: Environmental AI wave attacks (\"Purge\") on player bases, plus player vs. structure mechanics.
5. WORLD, RESPAWN @COMMENT_BODY@ PENALTY LOGIC
World State: Seamless open-world map with distinct biomes, resource yields, and enemy difficulty zones.
Death @COMMENT_BODY@ Respawn System:
Unlimited Revives: Player respawns at their built campsite, bed, or standard spawn point.
Death Penalty: Player retains character level, unlocked skill paths, and unlocked characters, but loses a percentage of held Coins/Points upon death.
6. DEVELOPMENT CONSTRAINTS @COMMENT_BODY@ CODE ARCHITECTURE
Code Style: Modular, readable, clean separation of concerns (keep Character Controller, Inventory, Building System, and Ability Manager in separate components/scripts).
Scalability: Ensure ability structures are modular so new characters, elemental types, and skill trees can be added via simple data tables orScriptableObjects/JSON. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
